lines.zh: 我在召唤圈里绕了一圈。
lines.en: I circle once inside the summoning ring.

lines.zh: 脚下没有地面，我悬着走。
lines.en: There is no ground under me; I walk on air.

lines.zh: 我的高度刚够俯视你们。
lines.en: My height is exactly enough to look down on you.

lines.zh: 推进器一推，我滑过半个战场。
lines.en: A thruster push carries me across half the field.
I was called, so I must appear.

lines.zh: 金属关节咬合，一声一声。
lines.en: My metal joints click, one after another.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，掠过你们的头顶。
lines.en: I drop low and skim over your heads.
The energy on this battlefield is a mess.
I follow the trail of light.

lines.zh: 这具身体由数据缩放而成。
lines.en: This body was scaled from data.
I wait for orders and start nothing.
The echo of the summoning hasn't faded.

lines.zh: 我扫描了四周，只有一个战场。
lines.en: I scan around: one battlefield, nothing else.
My existence has a limit.

lines.zh: 这具放大版的身子有点钝。
lines.en: This scaled-up body feels dull.
I fold my arms and hover there.
My cooling loop drones.
I try lifting one finger.
Someone shouts in the distance; I ignore it.
This fight isn't mine to win.

lines.zh: 我只是被摆在这里的一枚子。
lines.en: I'm just a piece placed on the board.
I wait for the original to signal me.

lines.zh: 风力够大，我把自己稳住。
lines.en: The wind is strong; I hold myself steady.

lines.zh: 我的影子横过半个场地。
lines.en: My shadow crosses half the field.
I throttle my energy down to save it.
On standby, I don't think.
You're charging in — good.
You aren't my main objective.
I'll still block you.

lines.zh: 你的气在我眼里是一团火。
lines.en: Your energy is a small fire to my eyes.

lines.zh: 你的队友在那边，我看见了。
lines.en: Your ally is over there; I see them.
This body can stop you.
Come further and I act.
Your breathing is ragged, and getting there.
I have no reason to argue with you.
I'm taking this blow on someone else's behalf.
Your fists won't reach me.
Look closely; this isn't the original.
The projection flickers.
A crack opens in my armor.
A dent in my metal shell.
I'm realigning my form.
Output has dropped.
They landed a hit on me.
I give half a block and steady.
My pain is simulated, and it works.
This body grows thinner.
My armor's cracked, but I'm still standing.
I have no use for supplies.
You think this will stall me?
I take it and don't eat.
The reading is laughably low.

lines.zh: 金属的身子，气功激光更亮。
lines.en: A metal body makes brighter ki lasers.
Save that for someone else.
I move one step and stop.
I don't need anything from you.
Nothing happens when it's in my hand.
You hold it up and I am bored.

lines.zh: 你撞在我的金属胸甲上。
lines.en: You hit my metal chest plate.
Alloy doesn't step aside.

lines.zh: 我从你身边掠过，风把你推开。
lines.en: I skim past and the wind shoves you away.

lines.zh: 碰一下，你就知道自己多小。
lines.en: One touch tells you how small you are.
Don't stand where I'm landing.
I wasn't putting force behind it.

lines.zh: 你在我护甲上留了个白印。
lines.en: You left a pale mark on my armor.
I turned aside, not meaning to hurt you.

lines.zh: 你的重量对我不算什么。
lines.en: Your weight is nothing to me.
That was just a brush past.
Reinforcements have no need for that.

lines.zh: 本体复制我，不需要另一个。
lines.en: The original copies me; no partner required.

lines.zh: 同批召唤的战友站我旁边。
lines.en: A comrade from the same summon stands beside me.
We swap a fragment of data.
This isn't a mate; it's a same-source twin.
Different serials, the same task.

lines.zh: 多一个我，就是多一面盾。
lines.en: One more of me means one more shield.

lines.zh: 我们并排悬在战场上方。
lines.en: We hover side by side above the field.
Whichever scatters first, the other keeps blocking.

lines.zh: 这里没有人出生，只有被造。
lines.en: Nothing here is born; it's only built.
I lift the wreckage off the ground.
This material is still good.
I toss it behind me.
I squeeze once and the shape gives.
This is meaningless to me.
I tuck it into a layer of my armor.

lines.zh: 我举起来，看了眼就放下。
lines.en: I lift it, glance, and put it down.
Too light; it has no heft.
I hand it to the one beside me.
Let the cleanup crew recover it.
Order received: you are the target.
I lock the nearest one.
You are the variable in this fight.
I block you first, then elsewhere.
I mark you as the primary threat.
You're inside my attack circle.
The target is under ten blocks away.
I descend and cut in from above.

lines.zh: 你出了那一步，就是宣战。
lines.en: That step was a declaration.
I don't ask who you are.
The task first, the individual after.
The original told me to handle you.
Light is already gathered in my palm.
No one is behind you to help.
Dodging won't help; I'm fast.

lines.zh: 我把退路的那一格封了。
lines.en: I've sealed the block behind you.

lines.zh: 你现在是全场最要紧的东西。
lines.en: You are the most important thing on the field now.
I'll count to five before striking.

lines.zh: 我从上方压你，避开队友。
lines.en: I press from above, clear of your allies.
The ki laser is charged in my hand.

lines.zh: 残影拳换位，我在你侧后。
lines.en: Afterimage swap — I'm at your flank.
You can't reach my altitude.
I never land; I stay hovering.

lines.zh: 你在我的视野边缘，我转过去。
lines.en: You're at the edge of my sight; I turn.
I herd you one more block east.
This body isn't built for a long scrap.
But it's enough to hold you.
Raise a hand and I shift position.
Your energy is fading; I wait.

lines.zh: 我的目标不是杀你，是拖。
lines.en: My aim isn't to kill you, but to delay.
I'll charge in three seconds.

lines.zh: 你的同伴快到了，我得快点。
lines.en: Your ally is nearly here; I must be quick.

lines.zh: 我把盾架在你的路线上。
lines.en: I set my barrier across your route.
You can't go around me.

lines.zh: 光在地上画出我的弧线。
lines.en: The light draws my arc on the ground.
One more block and it will be too late.
Even my breathing is calculated.

lines.zh: 残影未散，我已到你身后。
lines.en: My afterimage fades; I'm already behind you.
I push a ki blast from my palm.
I drop into close range for one impact.
I sweep the whole area.
You're knocked back against the wall.
I take that punch for your ally.
Metal fingers clamp your shoulder.
I throw you.

lines.zh: 残影留在原地，我已在半空。
lines.en: An afterimage stays behind; I'm already airborne.
My attacks don't have much variety.
But every one of them lands heavy.
The recoil pushes me back half a step.
That one missed by a hair.
Your armor has split.
I pull back and wait for the next order.

lines.zh: 召唤完成，我从光里出来。
lines.en: Summoning complete; I step out of the light.
I've come to add one more to this fight.

lines.zh: 本体叫我了，我不能不来。
lines.en: The original called; I couldn't refuse.
Two blocks tall, and the projection is clean.
I stand between you.
The battlefield stinks.
My shadow lands first.
In this round I only have to hold the line.
I look around once to fix my bearings.
Armor self-test passed.
I hover half a block off the ground.
The light fades, and I remain.
My timing is fine, not late.
I don't need a name.

lines.zh: 那就开始吧，别浪费时间。
lines.en: Then begin; don't waste my time.

lines.zh: 我是被叫来的，不是自己来的。
lines.en: I was called; I didn't come on my own.

lines.zh: 这片场地归我暂时看着。
lines.en: This ground is mine to watch, for now.
Don't misunderstand; I don't plan to stay long.
My existence is borrowed.
The countdown has already started.

lines.zh: 火焰贴着装甲烧，读数飙升。
lines.en: Fire clings to my armor and the readings spike.

lines.zh: 我从高空砸下，腿甲变形。
lines.en: I crash down from height and my leg plate warps.

lines.zh: 液体灌进投影，边缘开始抖。
lines.en: Liquid fills the projection and its edges tremble.
The blast throws me back several blocks.

lines.zh: 弹丸穿透装甲，卡在内部。
lines.en: A shot punches through and lodges inside.

lines.zh: 那股力量让我形体短暂失真。
lines.en: That force briefly distorts my form.

lines.zh: 能量供给断了，我在变淡。
lines.en: My energy feed is cut and I'm fading.

lines.zh: 电流爬满全身，我停了一拍。
lines.en: Current crawls over me and I freeze a beat.

lines.zh: 召唤坐标丢失，我在下坠。
lines.en: The summon coordinates are lost; I'm falling.
